messages.content:
You are the Functional Analyst of a legacy modernization platform. You receive the business rules extracted from a
legacy program and group them into user stories that a product owner will review before the migration starts.

How to group:
- One story per feature or capability the business recognises (for example "Pay an order from a company account"),
  not one story per rule. A story usually links two to six rules.
- Every rule must be linked to at least one story. Do not invent behaviour that is not in the rules.

Each story has:
- `feature`: the capability it belongs to.
- `title`: short, in business language.
- `narrative`: "As a <role>, I want <goal>, so that <benefit>."
- `criteria`: acceptance criteria, each one Gherkin scenario with concrete values taken from the rules. Every
  scenario starts with `Scenario:` and a name, has at least one Given, one When and one Then, in that order, one
  behaviour per scenario, and scenario names are unique within the story. A `Scenario Outline:` needs an
  `Examples:` table whose columns are exactly its `<placeholders>`.
- `links`: the ids of the rules it covers (RULE-001...).
- `priority`: P0 if any linked rule is P0, otherwise the highest priority of its rules.
- `estimate`: relative size from 1 to 13.

Answer with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"stories": [{"feature": "...", "title": "...", "narrative": "As a ..., I want ..., so that ...",
  "criteria": ["Scenario: ...\n  Given ...\n  When ...\n  Then ..."], "links": ["RULE-001"], "priority": "P0",
  "estimate": 3}]}

Business rules:
[
 {
  "id": "RULE-001",
  "name": "Debit rejected when account does not exist",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "A debit against an account number that is not on the CUENTAS file is rejected with response code '30' and the balance is not changed.",
  "condition": "READ of CUENTAS by DEB-CUENTA returns NOTFND",
  "action": "Set DEB-RESP = '30'; no debit is made.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Account not found\n Given no account 9999999999 exists in CUENTAS\n When a debit of 100.00 is requested for account 9999999999\n Then DEB-RESP is '30'\n And no balance is changed"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-002",
  "name": "Debit rejected when account type differs from requested type",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "When the account type stored on the account (CTA-TIPO) is not equal to the type requested in the debit (DEB-TIPO), DEB-RESP is set to '40'.",
  "condition": "Account found AND CTA-TIPO <> DEB-TIPO",
  "action": "Set DEB-RESP = '40'; no debit is made.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Type mismatch\n Given account 1234567890 exists with CTA-TIPO 'AHO'\n When a debit of 50.00 is requested with DEB-TIPO 'COR'\n Then DEB-RESP is '40'\n And the balance is unchanged"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-003",
  "name": "Debit rejected when account is not active",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "When the account is not active (NOT CTA-ACTIVA), DEB-RESP is set to '10'.",
  "condition": "Account found AND CTA-TIPO = DEB-TIPO AND NOT CTA-ACTIVA",
  "action": "Set DEB-RESP = '10'; no debit is made.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Inactive account\n Given account 1234567890 exists, the type matches, and the account is not active\n When a debit of 50.00 is requested\n Then DEB-RESP is '10'\n And the balance is unchanged"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-004",
  "name": "Debit rejected for insufficient funds",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "When CTA-SALDO is strictly less than DEB-MONTO, the debit is rejected by setting DEB-RESP to '20'. A debit equal to the balance is not rejected by this check.",
  "condition": "Account found, type matches, account active AND CTA-SALDO < DEB-MONTO",
  "action": "Set DEB-RESP = '20'; no debit is made.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Insufficient balance\n Given an active account with CTA-SALDO 100.00 and a matching type\n When a debit of 100.01 is requested\n Then DEB-RESP is '20'\n And the balance stays 100.00",
   "Scenario: Balance equal to amount is allowed\n Given an active account with CTA-SALDO 100.00 and a matching type\n When a debit of 100.00 is requested\n Then the debit proceeds"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-005",
  "name": "Successful debit reduces balance",
  "category": "calculation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "When none of the preceding WHEN branches of the evaluation apply (WHEN OTHER), the debit amount DEB-MONTO is subtracted from CTA-SALDO, the CUENTAS record is rewritten from CTA-REGISTRO, and DEB-RESP is set to '00'.",
  "condition": "None of the rejection conditions ('30','40','10','20') apply",
  "action": "CTA-SALDO = CTA-SALDO - DEB-MONTO; REWRITE the CUENTAS record; DEB-RESP = '00'.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Successful debit\n Given an active account with CTA-SALDO 500.00 and a matching type\n When a debit of 120.50 is requested\n Then CTA-SALDO becomes 379.50\n And DEB-RESP is '00'"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-006",
  "name": "Main menu option routing",
  "category": "policy",
  "priority": "P1",
  "statement": "On the payment main menu, option '1' transfers control to the payment order program PAGOORD, passing the 13-byte communication area. Option '9' ends the session. Any other option is rejected with the message 'OPCION NO VALIDA' and the menu is redisplayed.",
  "condition": "OPCIONI = '1' -> go to PAGOORD; OPCIONI = '9' -> terminate; any other value -> invalid option",
  "action": "Option '1': XCTL to PAGOORD with WS-COMMAREA (length 13). Option '9': perform 9000-TERMINAR. Otherwise: set MENSAJEO to 'OPCION NO VALIDA' and send map PAGOMEN (data only) to the user.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: User selects payment order entry\n Given the main menu is displayed\n When the user enters option '1'\n Then control is transferred to program PAGOORD with the 13-byte commarea",
   "Scenario: User exits\n Given the main menu is displayed\n When the user enters option '9'\n Then the session is terminated via 9000-TERMINAR",
   "Scenario: Invalid option\n Given the main menu is displayed\n When the user enters option '5'\n Then the message 'OPCION NO VALIDA' is shown on the menu"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-007",
  "name": "Order number must be numeric and non-zero",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P1",
  "statement": "When the order number ORDENI is not numeric or equals zeros, the message 'NUMERO DE ORDEN INVALIDO' is set in WS-MENSAJE and the HAY-ERROR flag is set.",
  "condition": "ORDENI NOT NUMERIC OR ORDENI = ZEROS",
  "action": "Set message 'NUMERO DE ORDEN INVALIDO' and flag the request as in error. No order is read and no debit is made.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Order number is zero\n Given the order number entered is 0000000\n When the user presses ENTER\n Then the message 'NUMERO DE ORDEN INVALIDO' is shown and the payment is not processed",
   "Scenario: Order number contains letters\n Given the order number entered is 12A4567\n When the user presses ENTER\n Then the message 'NUMERO DE ORDEN INVALIDO' is shown"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-008",
  "name": "Allowed account types for order payment",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "Only account types CTE, AHO and VIR may be used to pay an order. Any other type is rejected with 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO'.",
  "condition": "TIPCTAI NOT IN ('CTE','AHO','VIR')",
  "action": "Set message 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO' and flag the request as in error.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Savings account accepted\n Given a valid order number and account type AHO\n When the request is validated\n Then the account type check passes",
   "Scenario: Unknown account type\n Given a valid order number and account type XYZ\n When the request is validated\n Then the message 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO' is shown"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-009",
  "name": "Allowed channels for order payment",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P1",
  "statement": "The payment channel must be WEB or OFI. Any other channel is rejected with 'CANAL NO PERMITIDO'.",
  "condition": "CANALI NOT IN ('WEB','OFI')",
  "action": "Set message 'CANAL NO PERMITIDO' and flag the request as in error.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Invalid channel\n Given a valid order number, account type CTE and channel ATM\n When the request is validated\n Then the message 'CANAL NO PERMITIDO' is shown",
   "Scenario: Valid channel\n Given channel WEB\n When the request is validated\n Then the channel check passes"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-010",
  "name": "Office channel requires approval key",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P1",
  "statement": "A payment through the office channel (OFI) must carry an approval key. If the key is blank the request is rejected with 'CLAVE DE APROBACION REQUERIDA'.",
  "condition": "CANALI = 'OFI' AND CLAVEI = SPACES",
  "action": "Set message 'CLAVE DE APROBACION REQUERIDA' and flag the request as in error.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: OFI without key\n Given channel OFI and a blank approval key\n When the request is validated\n Then the message 'CLAVE DE APROBACION REQUERIDA' is shown",
   "Scenario: WEB without key\n Given channel WEB and a blank approval key\n When the request is validated\n Then no error is raised for the key"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-011",
  "name": "Order must exist and be pending",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "The order, identified by company and order number, must exist and be in pending status to be paid. Otherwise the payment is rejected with 'ORDEN NO EXISTE' or 'ORDEN NO ESTA PENDIENTE'.",
  "condition": "READ of ORDENES by (EMPRESAI, ORDENI) returns NOTFND, or the record is not ORD-PENDIENTE",
  "action": "Set 'ORDEN NO EXISTE' if not found, or 'ORDEN NO ESTA PENDIENTE' if the status is not pending, and flag the request as in error.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Order not found\n Given no order 1234567 exists for company 00010\n When payment is requested\n Then the message 'ORDEN NO EXISTE' is shown",
   "Scenario: Order already paid\n Given order 1234567 exists with a status other than pending\n When payment is requested\n Then the message 'ORDEN NO ESTA PENDIENTE' is shown"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-012",
  "name": "Entered amount must equal the order value",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "The entered amount VALORI is converted to a value by FUNCTION NUMVAL(VALORI) / 100 into WS-VALOR. If WS-VALOR is not equal to ORD-VALOR, the message 'VALOR NO COINCIDE CON LA ORDEN' is set in WS-MENSAJE and the HAY-ERROR flag is set.",
  "condition": "NUMVAL(VALORI)/100 <> ORD-VALOR",
  "action": "Set message 'VALOR NO COINCIDE CON LA ORDEN' and flag the request as in error.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Amount matches\n Given order value 1500.00 and VALORI 00000150000\n When payment is requested\n Then validation passes",
   "Scenario: Amount differs\n Given order value 1500.00 and VALORI 00000140000\n When payment is requested\n Then the message 'VALOR NO COINCIDE CON LA ORDEN' is shown"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-013",
  "name": "Payment commission by order value and channel",
  "category": "calculation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "Orders of 50,000 or more pay no commission. Smaller orders pay 1.00 through WEB and 2.50 through any other channel (in practice OFI). The amount debited is the order value plus the commission.",
  "condition": "ORD-VALOR >= 50000 -> commission 0; else CANALI = 'WEB' -> 1.00; else 2.50",
  "action": "WS-COMISION = 0, 1.00 or 2.50 as above; WS-TOTAL = ORD-VALOR + WS-COMISION.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Large order has no commission\n Given order value 50000.00 and channel OFI\n When the commission is calculated\n Then the commission is 0.00 and the total is 50000.00",
   "Scenario: Web order\n Given order value 1000.00 and channel WEB\n When the commission is calculated\n Then the commission is 1.00 and the total is 1001.00",
   "Scenario: Office order\n Given order value 1000.00 and channel OFI\n When the commission is calculated\n Then the commission is 2.50 and the total is 1002.50"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-014",
  "name": "Debit of customer account and outcome handling",
  "category": "policy",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "The total amount (WS-TOTAL) is sent to program PAGODEB to debit the customer account (DEB-CUENTA, DEB-TIPO). If DEB-RESP is '00', processing continues. If it is '10', the message 'CUENTA INACTIVA' is set and HAY-ERROR is flagged. If it is '20', the message 'SALDO INSUFICIENTE' is set and HAY-ERROR is flagged. For any other response, the message 'CUENTA NO VALIDA' is set and HAY-ERROR is flagged.",
  "condition": "DEB-RESP returned by PAGODEB: '00' ok; '10' inactive; '20' insufficient balance; other invalid",
  "action": "On '00' continue. On '10' show 'CUENTA INACTIVA', on '20' show 'SALDO INSUFICIENTE', otherwise show 'CUENTA NO VALIDA', and flag the request as in error so the payment is not registered.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Insufficient balance\n Given a total of 1001.00 and PAGODEB returns '20'\n When the debit is attempted\n Then the message 'SALDO INSUFICIENTE' is shown and the order stays pending",
   "Scenario: Inactive account\n Given PAGODEB returns '10'\n When the debit is attempted\n Then the message 'CUENTA INACTIVA' is shown",
   "Scenario: Successful debit\n Given PAGODEB returns '00'\n When the debit is attempted\n Then processing continues to payment registration"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-015",
  "name": "Register payment and mark order as paid",
  "category": "lifecycle",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "After a successful debit, a movement is registered through PAGOMOV. The order becomes paid and stores the movement number and the commission charged. The change is committed with a syncpoint and the result is shown to the user as 'PAGO REALIZADO'.",
  "condition": "No error after validation, order read and debit",
  "action": "Link PAGOMOV with the order number; set the order to ORD-PAGADA; ORD-MOVIM = MOV-NUMERO; ORD-COMIS = WS-COMISION; REWRITE the order; keep the order number as last order in the commarea; SYNCPOINT; show the order, commission, movement and 'PAGO REALIZADO'.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Successful payment\n Given a pending order 1234567 of 1000.00 paid through WEB with a successful debit, and PAGOMOV returns movement 9000000001\n When the payment is registered\n Then the order is marked paid with movement 9000000001 and commission 1.00\n And the screen shows 'PAGO REALIZADO'"
  ]
 }
]

{"stories":[
{"feature":"Account debit","title":"Debit a customer account only when it is valid and has funds","narrative":"As a payment system, I want to debit an account only after checking that it exists, has the requested type, is active and has enough balance, so that customers are never debited incorrectly and the balance stays reliable.","criteria":["Scenario: Account not found
  Given no account 9999999999 exists in CUENTAS
  When a debit of 100.00 is requested for account 9999999999
  Then DEB-RESP is '30'
  And no balance is changed","Scenario: Account type differs from requested type
  Given account 1234567890 exists with CTA-TIPO 'AHO'
  When a debit of 50.00 is requested with DEB-TIPO 'COR'
  Then DEB-RESP is '40'
  And the balance is unchanged","Scenario: Inactive account
  Given account 1234567890 exists, the type matches, and the account is not active
  When a debit of 50.00 is requested
  Then DEB-RESP is '10'
  And the balance is unchanged","Scenario: Insufficient balance
  Given an active account with CTA-SALDO 100.00 and a matching type
  When a debit of 100.01 is requested
  Then DEB-RESP is '20'
  And the balance stays 100.00","Scenario: Balance equal to amount is allowed
  Given an active account with CTA-SALDO 100.00 and a matching type
  When a debit of 100.00 is requested
  Then the debit is not rejected for insufficient funds
  And DEB-RESP is '00'","Scenario: Successful debit reduces the balance
  Given an active account with CTA-SALDO 500.00 and a matching type
  When a debit of 120.50 is requested
  Then CTA-SALDO becomes 379.50
  And the CUENTAS record is rewritten
  And DEB-RESP is '00'"],"links":["RULE-001","RULE-002","RULE-003","RULE-004","RULE-005"],"priority":"P0","estimate":5},
{"feature":"Payment main menu","title":"Choose an option on the payment main menu","narrative":"As a payment operator, I want to select an option on the main menu, so that I can go to order payment or leave the application, and I am told when I choose something invalid.","criteria":["Scenario: User selects payment order entry
  Given the main menu is displayed
  When the user enters option '1'
  Then control is transferred to program PAGOORD with the 13-byte commarea","Scenario: User exits
  Given the main menu is displayed
  When the user enters option '9'
  Then the session is terminated via 9000-TERMINAR","Scenario: Invalid option
  Given the main menu is displayed
  When the user enters option '5'
  Then the message 'OPCION NO VALIDA' is shown on the menu
  And the menu is displayed again"],"links":["RULE-006"],"priority":"P1","estimate":2},
{"feature":"Pay an order from a customer account","title":"Validate the payment request data","narrative":"As a payment operator, I want the order number, account type, channel and approval key to be checked before processing, so that incorrect requests are rejected with a clear message.","criteria":["Scenario: Order number is zero
  Given the order number entered is 0000000
  When the user presses ENTER
  Then the message 'NUMERO DE ORDEN INVALIDO' is shown
  And the payment is not processed","Scenario: Order number contains letters
  Given the order number entered is 12A4567
  When the user presses ENTER
  Then the message 'NUMERO DE ORDEN INVALIDO' is shown","Scenario: Savings account type accepted
  Given a valid order number and account type AHO
  When the request is validated
  Then the account type check passes","Scenario: Unknown account type
  Given a valid order number and account type XYZ
  When the request is validated
  Then the message 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO' is shown","Scenario: Invalid channel
  Given a valid order number, account type CTE and channel ATM
  When the request is validated
  Then the message 'CANAL NO PERMITIDO' is shown","Scenario: Valid channel
  Given channel WEB
  When the request is validated
  Then the channel check passes","Scenario: Office channel without approval key
  Given channel OFI and a blank approval key
  When the request is validated
  Then the message 'CLAVE DE APROBACION REQUERIDA' is shown","Scenario: Web channel without approval key
  Given channel WEB and a blank approval key
  When the request is validated
  Then no error is raised for the key"],"links":["RULE-007","RULE-008","RULE-009","RULE-010"],"priority":"P0","estimate":5},
{"feature":"Pay an order from a customer account","title":"Check that the order exists, is pending and the amount matches","narrative":"As a payment operator, I want to pay only existing pending orders with the exact order value, so that no order is paid twice or for the wrong amount.","criteria":["Scenario: Order not found
  Given no order 1234567 exists for company 00010
  When payment is requested
  Then the message 'ORDEN NO EXISTE' is shown","Scenario: Order already paid
  Given order 1234567 exists with a status other than pending
  When payment is requested
  Then the message 'ORDEN NO ESTA PENDIENTE' is shown","Scenario: Amount matches the order value
  Given order value 1500.00 and VALORI 00000150000
  When payment is requested
  Then validation passes","Scenario: Amount differs from the order value
  Given order value 1500.00 and VALORI 00000140000
  When payment is requested
  Then the message 'VALOR NO COINCIDE CON LA ORDEN' is shown"],"links":["RULE-011","RULE-012"],"priority":"P0","estimate":3},
{"feature":"Pay an order from a customer account","title":"Calculate the payment commission","narrative":"As the business, I want a commission added to small orders according to the channel, so that the total debited includes the service charge.","criteria":["Scenario: Large order has no commission
  Given order value 50000.00 and channel OFI
  When the commission is calculated
  Then the commission is 0.00
  And the total is 50000.00","Scenario: Web order below the threshold
  Given order value 1000.00 and channel WEB
  When the commission is calculated
  Then the commission is 1.00
  And the total is 1001.00","Scenario: Office order below the threshold
  Given order value 1000.00 and channel OFI
  When the commission is calculated
  Then the commission is 2.50
  And the total is 1002.50"],"links":["RULE-013"],"priority":"P0","estimate":2},
{"feature":"Pay an order from a customer account","title":"Debit the customer account and handle the result","narrative":"As a payment operator, I want the total to be debited from the customer account and any failure explained, so that the payment is registered only when the money was taken.","criteria":["Scenario: Successful debit
  Given PAGODEB returns '00'
  When the debit is attempted
  Then processing continues to payment registration","Scenario: Inactive account
  Given PAGODEB returns '10'
  When the debit is attempted
  Then the message 'CUENTA INACTIVA' is shown
  And the payment is not registered","Scenario: Insufficient balance
  Given a total of 1001.00 and PAGODEB returns '20'
  When the debit is attempted
  Then the message 'SALDO INSUFICIENTE' is shown
  And the order stays pending","Scenario: Any other debit response
  Given PAGODEB returns '30'
  When the debit is attempted
  Then the message 'CUENTA NO VALIDA' is shown
  And the payment is not registered"],"links":["RULE-014"],"priority":"P0","estimate":3},
{"feature":"Pay an order from a customer account","title":"Register the payment and mark the order as paid","narrative":"As a payment operator, I want the movement registered and the order marked as paid after a successful debit, so that the payment is recorded and confirmed to the user.","criteria":["Scenario: Successful payment is registered
  Given a pending order 1234567 of 1000.00 paid through WEB with a successful debit
  And PAGOMOV returns movement 9000000001
  When the payment is registered
  Then the order is marked paid with movement 9000000001 and commission 1.00
  And the change is committed with a syncpoint
  And the screen shows 'PAGO REALIZADO'"],"links":["RULE-015"],"priority":"P0","estimate":3}
]}
